About this item

Product details

Spicy food lovers will be singing your praises with Del Duca authentic Italian cured pork. Hot Calabrese and Pepper Salami, made from savory ground pork, and the delicacy of Capocollo pork shoulder, all bring the heat without being overbearing. Dry-cured, sliced, and ready to enjoy so you can spend more time enjoying the smiles of approval when Del Duca deli meat is on the table. Del Duca Variety comes in a 6 oz plastic tray.
